lines.2: 「My goal is to live without being swept away by the mood.」
lines.3: 「I'll study what offended her and use it next time.」
lines.4: 「Well, look at that. He really went after her.」
lines.9: 「I have nothing to say to you, Senpai.」
lines.10: 「Why...? I can't make any sense of you.」
lines.12: 「Don't touch me so casually. You're annoying.」
lines.14: 「You'll regret putting on an angry performance like this later.」
lines.17: 「This is where the phrase 'none of your business' applies.」
lines.18: 「How is it none of my business?」
lines.20: 「God, you're annoying. Stop interfering with me. I told you it's disgusting.」
lines.24: All I did was praise her cooking and recommend her.
